_comment: Golden dataset manifest — hand-curated (JD, reference output) pairs; references are the strongest material actually sent, not verified-5/5 outputs (see _labels_note). reference_file resolves against the workspace optimized-resumes folder; jd_file against workspace/evals/golden (see evals/golden.py). The files themselves are personal data and are NOT committed. JD provenance: recovered verbatim from the application queue (2026-07-29), except GD-02 which is the condensed JD preserved in the Agent 365 cover-letter args — replace with the full posting if recovered.
_labels_note: labels = human rubric scores on the reference outputs, scored blind (before seeing any judge output for these files) by the resume owner against the master resume, 2026-08-04. Single rater, one sitting, RESUME_RUBRIC anchors verbatim. These calibrate the judge (compare judge means to labels per dimension); they do not validate suite scores on newly generated outputs. Note the accuracy labels: the owner found hallucinations in four of five references — 'golden' here means best-available application material, not hallucination-free ground truth.
